system: Stremiium Agent Disaster Recovery & State Backup Specification
point_in_time_rollback_procedure: 1. COORD-Git-State-SafeGuard identifies corrupted commit or failing agent manifest.
2. Freeze active agent task execution via COORD-Workflow-Orchestrator barrier lock.
3. Revert working tree to last certified Git release tag.
4. Restore state snapshot from hourly incremental backup store.
5. Re-run CI/CD validation suite and verify 100% benchmark compliance before unlocking queues.
